description: visible = false deactivates a pack: it is hidden and can no longer be bought; members who have it keep it. visible = true activates it again. This is the safe way to stop selling a pack. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.
